Paris (June 4, 1539) likely used UTC+0 historically, but per given reference offsets: Europe/Athens = +2, so Europe/Paris also +2 (standard).  
Sydney offset = +10.  
Target time = 04:00 + (10 − 2) = 04:00 + 8 = 12:00 same day.  
No date change needed for time-only wrap.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 12:00
